fields.title: Cap the Double 11 serum pre-sale at 8,000 units and add a restock alert
fields.cause: 2,000 of 10,000 serums are held at customs until Nov 12; the session is on Nov 10. Selling past the stock on hand repeats the Nov 4 waitlist.
fields.plan: Set the purchase limit to 8,000 in the Taobao Live console; pin a restock-alert card for the held units; set up the red-packet rain before 18:00.

fields.title: Move 300 cleansers from Singapore to Jakarta before 11.11
fields.cause: Payday sold through 300 more cleansers than planned; Jakarta holds 2,700 of 3,000.
fields.plan: Book the overnight transfer from the Singapore warehouse; if it misses Nov 10, lower the flash-sale quantity to 2,700.

fields.title: Approve the three pending affiliate clips and switch on the Black Friday coupon
fields.cause: Three of eight creator clips wait for brand review and the coupon is still a draft; the session is on Nov 14.
fields.plan: Review the three clips with brand on Nov 10; publish the coupon on Nov 12 and test it on a staff account.

fields.title: Switch candle shipments to double-wall cartons and file the carrier claim
fields.cause: 171 of 1,410 Halloween orders arrived with cracked glass; the carrier confirmed crushed single-wall cartons. Black Friday candles ship from the same 3PL.
fields.plan: Change the packing spec at the Reno 3PL to double-wall cartons before Nov 12; file the claim for the 171 orders.

fields.title: Ship or refund the 1,900 waitlisted serum orders
fields.cause: The serum sold out 40 minutes in; 1,900 orders wait for stock and buyers are cancelling.
fields.plan: Message waitlisted buyers with a ship date of Nov 13 and a small coupon; refund anyone who asks within 24 hours.

fields.title: Add an audio check and a voucher check to the Shopee pre-live checklist
fields.cause: The payday live lost 25 minutes of audio and ran without its voucher.
fields.plan: Both checks added on Nov 3; the 11.11 session’s checklist already includes them.
